notes: ACCESS: exactly as the prior Home-Decor pass - plain curl is Akamai 403, curl_cffi impersonate=chrome131 returned 200 on every request; no proxy or reader service needed. TREE: /main_sitemap.xml (1,235 URLs -> 262 base /c:<id>/ category nodes) cross-checked against the mega-menu taxonomy in window.__HABITAT_INITIAL_PROPS__ present on every page. The mega-menu exposed 5 node IDs absent from the sitemap (furniture/sideboards c:809212, furniture/bookcases-and-shelving c:809214, storage/display-cabinets c:827791, storage/storage-benches-and-ottomans c:809344, furniture/dining-table-and-chair-sets c:809210) and the bedroom-storage listing page exposed 3 more (shoe-storage c:809195, baskets-and-boxes c:827794, storage-bags c:1000226). The on-page M052 visual-nav carousel was inspected but is a curated marketing strip, not the taxonomy, so it was not used for structure. COUNTS: rendered listing header, span data-test="result-count". Every one of the 61 leaves was verified THREE ways and all three agreed exactly on all 61: (1) the header text, (2) JSON-LD CollectionPage.mainEntity.numberOfItems, (3) a full-pagination harvest of unique product URLs from the JSON-LD ItemList (60 per page via /opt/page:N/). Per the prior pass's trap, product tiles were NOT counted by raw /product/ hrefs because recommendation carousels inject extra links; the JSON-LD ItemList was used instead. SANITY CHECKS: counts differ per category (no site-wide constant); no suspiciously round numbers; the h1 of every page loaded matched the intended category (no silent parent-serve); a second forced re-read of Sofas (178), Wardrobes (105) and Garden furniture sets (82) returned identical numbers, so no intra-session drift; one page past the end 404s (sofas p4, wardrobes p3) while the last real page 200s, so ceil(N/60) is exact. PARENT/CHILD PARTITION CHECKS by product-ID set: Sofas and armchairs 101+55+106+178 covers exactly the 440 parent with zero orphans; Kids furniture (259), Kids storage (79), Nursery furniture (100), Bathroom storage (28) and Cube storage (17) are each covered exactly by their children with zero orphans; Beds 117 leaves 2 items outside its 4 children and Bedroom storage 103 leaves 6 outside its 7 children - in both cases the children are still the correct leaves and no child item sits outside its parent. Only leaves carry qty, so overlapping children (e.g. Ottoman and storage beds vs Bed frames) are never summed. DUPLICATE NODE IDs RESOLVED: five node pairs are identical listings published under two different c: ids - furniture/sideboards c:809212 == storage/sideboards c:809343 (40/40 ID overlap), furniture/bookcases-and-shelving c:809214 == storage/bookcases-and-shelving c:809337 (59/59), storage/display-cabinets c:827791 == furniture/display-cabinets c:827781 (9/9), storage/storage-benches-and-ottomans c:809344 == furniture/bedroom-storage/storage-benches-and-ottomans c:809196 (18/18), furniture/bedroom-storage/shoe-storage c:809195 == storage/shoe-storage c:809342 (15/15). Each is emitted ONCE, at the URL the page's own rel=canonical points to. Dining room sets c:809210 likewise canonicalises to the /dining-table-and-chair-sets/ slug, which is what is recorded. EXCLUDED after opening the listing and reading the product titles: Mattresses c:809205, Kids mattresses c:827780 (31) and Cot and cot bed mattresses c:1001365 (13) - bedding per brief; Wardrobe components c:827784 (13) - internal shelves and drawer inserts, i.e. furniture parts; Overdoor storage c:1000225 (3) - hooks, a hanging basket and a shower caddy; Toy boxes c:828054 (23) - toy boxes, storage chests, trunks and rope baskets, i.e. standalone storage goods; Trunks c:809345 (6) - all fabric/kids storage trunks and chests; Garden storage boxes and cupboards c:1042950 (6) - all Keter/Lifetime plastic outdoor storage boxes; Radiator covers c:826683 (12) - all 12 are Chevron radiator covers, a fixture cover not a furniture piece; Wall mounted and floating shelves c:824780 (16) - all wall shelves, which the brief assigns to Wall Decor; Kitchen racks and shelves c:827768 (2) - a worktop organiser and a spice rack; Kids baskets and boxes, bedroom-storage baskets-and-boxes / storage-bags / clothes-hangers, decorative baskets and boxes, cube storage boxes and laundry baskets - standalone storage goods; Gift cards; and per the brief all lighting, mirrors, textiles, tableware, cookware, electricals, bathroom fixtures and accessories, artificial plants, planters, wallpaper, Christmas nodes, garden parasols, furniture covers, outdoor cushions and rugs, barbecues, chimineas, fire pits, gazebos, pergolas, summer houses, teepees, clothes airers and ironing boards.
